## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`areas/cli.json` 新增区级配方 `cli-18-prerelease-db`,`organization-ownership-ceremony` 的 acceptance[5] 引用它(revision 5 → 6);`packages/qa/dogfood` 里提交一份由 18.0.0-next.5 自己的 `os dev` 生成的数据库文本快照(约 400 KB)和它的生成脚本。
- 为什么改:acceptance[5] 需要「18.0 预发布版创建并服务过的数据库」,每次都得在 tag commit 上单独构建,两轮 18.2.0 都只能记 blocked(fixture);现在一条命令恢复即可。
- 风险与回滚:只动 QA 台账 JSON 和私有包 `@objectstack/dogfood` 的 test 目录(不进测试套件、不发布),不碰产品代码;回滚即 revert。
- 先看:`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` 顶部 `fixtures` 块;`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts` 的 `useTheRelease` 与 `census`;history revision 6。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsx test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts restore --to /tmp/n5check/n5.db`,预期打印 restored … born under @objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5 (820fd5aef0d6)。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/cli.json` gains an area-level `fixtures` block with one recipe, `cli-18-prerelease-db`, in the README's "Area-level `fixtures`" shape. Its `sequence` is what a runner replays: restore the committed dump into two new SQLite files (the primary and the telemetry sibling `os dev` keeps beside a file primary), then read the census it should hold. A `regenerate` entry names how the dump is remade from the tag.
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` (revision 5 → 6) opts in with `fixtures.provisioning.use` + `why`; `fixtures.requires[2]` names the recipe first and keeps the by-hand tag build as its fallback; `knownGaps[2]` is rewritten as CLOSED-by-recipe; `steps[5]` names the restored pair and that the delivery row lands in the telemetry sibling under `--dev`; `history` records the re-drive and its verdict. No clause sentence, verify or evidence changed.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts` (new, not a test; vitest never collects it): `restore` loads the dump; `generate` builds or takes a worktree of the `@objectstack/cli@18.0.0-next.5` tag commit, boots that commit's own `os dev --seed-admin` over a fresh file DB, drives its HTTP doors (`useTheRelease`), stops it, takes a census that refuses a database missing anything acceptance[5] reads, and writes the dump. It reuses `sqlite-text-dump.ts` from the same harness.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/fixture-18.0.0-next.5/` (new): `database.sql` (198,531 B), `telemetry.sql` (202,762 B), `manifest.json` (5,573 B, ref, sha `820fd5aef0`, census, people).

## Why

acceptance[5] (P0) scored `blocked(fixture)` in waves 1 and 2 (QA runs #25812, #26481): it needs a database an 18.0 pre-release created and served, which took a tag-commit build each run, and an npm install of the published pre-release CLI is no substitute (it resolves 18.1 dependencies). The card asked for one choice and its size: **a committed fixture**, as SQLite text (406,866 bytes in all, well under the ~1 MB line where the card preferred a script), so a run needs no build at all; the generator is committed beside it so the dump is only ever made by repo tooling and can be remade from the tag.

The doors the generator drives are the ones fixtures.requires[2] lists (QA run #24838's by-hand sequence): admin sign-in, the global `mail` settings written twice, member A invited + signed up + accepted, member B by admin create-user, a password reset and a verification resend, a second pending invitation, the declared webhook's mirror row activated, an admin task and a member task. The mail settings point SMTP at a closed local port with queued delivery and `OS_EMAIL_RETRIES=10` on the boot, so each queued mail fails fast and waits as a `pending` `email.send.async` job: the jobs the ceremony re-points exist without planting a row by hand.

## Tests

No product code changed. The generator and the restore were run, and the clause was re-driven once on the restore.

## Acceptance notes

- The recipe is a restore, not a runtime provisioning on a live boot like this ledger's other recipes; its `$comment` says so, and the item's own steps then boot the run subject's stock showcase over the restored pair.
- Reads the recipe's `knownGaps` keep: no magic-link mail and no `email.attachment.reclaim` job (18.0.0-next.5's served composition mounts no magic-link door; identity mail carries no attachment), so those clause arms read nothing; every mail job is `pending`, none `completed`. The second boot retries the re-pointed sends, so the moved rows' `attempt_count`/`updated_at` advance after it: compare at the apply for byte-equality. No `sys_http_delivery` exists before the upgrade (on 18.0.0-next.5 the organization-less declared webhook refuses to fan out), so `deliveriesResourced` is 0 and the delivery leg is the post-upgrade PATCH.
- A production `os serve` boot over the restored pair is NOT MEASURED; the recipe requires `--dev` throughout, because the telemetry sibling is part of the `os dev` composition the database was born in.
- `scripts/gen-upgrade-harness-fixture.mjs`'s header still says two fixtures live in that directory; this third one has its own generator. Not touched (outside this card's paths).

## Verification

Gates at head 884054f2 (branch merged with origin/main c8583f80): `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 49 commands; all 49 exit 0, and `--ran` reconciles 49 derived, 49 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED. Three needed this container's build state first, none of them for this diff: `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (exit 3 on the shallow clone until its pinned positive-control commit was fetched), `check:dts-closure` (exit 1) and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET) until a full `turbo run build`. `pnpm check:platform-checklist`: OK, 7 area recipes, 12 item references resolved, 7/7 recipes referenced, symbol anchors 1004/1014 resolved (10 on the named residual). The new script: eslint exit 0, and `tsc --noEmit` over it with the dogfood tsconfig's compiler options exit 0 (the package's whole typecheck is CI's `Type Check · workspace` lane). No dogfood test file changed and the new script is not collected, so no dogfood battery ran. No changeset: `docs/qa/**` and the private `@objectstack/dogfood` publish nothing (`skip-changeset`).
